headline: Casualty Tolls Climb on Static Fronts as Farranac Coast Flares Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition the map has scarcely moved, yet the casualty columns swell at a startling rate. Stonecradle now tops the ledger, near twenty-six thousand fallen in the past day with its three-Warden, six-Colonial division unchanged, hourly losses there more than doubled. The Weathered Expanse, still split five Warden to four Colonial, has recorded no base action since early evening, but its guns exact roughly a thousand losses an hour apiece. Farranac Coast stirs near midnight: two fresh events inside two hours, Transient Valley having seen eight actions through the day, while ten Colonial bases and one ruin still define the region. Callahan's Passage and Mooring County both quicken, neither flag having shifted in recent hours, and the Nevish Line's evening storm has cooled from its peak. The Linn of Mercy keeps all eleven bases under Colonial colors, silent since 19:41, and the Dead Lands, quieter now, still cost the Wardens more than five thousand in the day. Fisherman's Row, the Gutter and Stlican Shelf have gone still. No victor is declared on the war's 344th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
